messages:
Nina H.: quick run notes from a quant sweep on orion9p-int4 against convo-assistant (7k dialogs). trying to understand per-turn regression vs unit-econ wins — posting microbench + suggested rollout.

Tom B.: please paste the numbers

Nina H.: ```
model: orion9p-int4 (calib: default)
slice: convo_assistant_prod_sample (~7k dialogs)
avg tokens/turn: 45
avg turns/session: 6
latency p95: 120ms (single-shard)
latency p99: 420ms
qps (shard): 32
cost / 1M tokens (hosted): $6.10
baseline (orion9p-int6) cost / 1M: $9.00  (~32% cost improvement vs int6)
quality vs int6 baseline (aggregate):
  - helpfulness proxy (auto-label): 82.3 -> 80.1  (-2.2)
  - instruction-follow F1: 88.0 -> 86.5 (-1.5)
  - persona-consistency drift (heuristic): 1.2% -> 2.7% (+1.5pp)
turn-level notes: edge-case follow-ups (ellided context) show increased drop; short single-turn prompts are barely affected.
calibration attempt (denser set) recovered ~0.4 helpfulness pts in a follow-up run.
```

Lin W.: surface translation: the -2.2 helpfulness ~maps to ~1.2% net DAU impact on our assistant telemetry on this slice (varies by cohort). savings are meaningful for high-volume chat.

Jorge M.: infra note 31 p99 420ms is OK for most chat but could spike in multimodal routes. consider smaller batch_size for low-latency routes or a separate low-latency pool.

Tom B.: product POV: 1.2% DAU delta is within "action threshold" for free-tier but risky for paid SLAs. can we protect paid users with routing?

Nina H.: Mitigation & rollout ideas:
- tiered routing: paid users -> int6 by default; free users -> int4. allow on-the-fly upgrade for safety-critical system prompts.
- turn-aware hybrid routing: route turns >N tokens or turns flagged by an "integrity" classifier to int6. cheap classifier runs inline (tiny NN).
- synthetic probes + shadow testing: run a 10% shadow of int6 alongside int4 to estimate divergence in near-real-time (sampling every 2h).
- denser calibration: run quant calib with 5x more examples focusing on ellided-context cases (we saw +0.4 recovery).
- canary: 10% free-tier traffic for 7 days, monitor helpfulness, persona-drift, and latency tails.

Lin W.: operational thresholds proposal:
- if helpfulness drop >1.0pt sustained 24h -> throttle back to 50% int4
- if helpfulness drop >1.5pt OR persona-drift +1.0pp sustained 48h -> rollback to 100% int6
- p99 latency increase >+200ms for 12h -> investigate (not auto-rollback unless user-impacting)

Jorge M.: infra flags to set:
- route_tag: convo-orion-hybrid-v1
- tiered_flag: paid_force_int6=true
- integrity_classifier_threshold: 0.65
- shadow_sample_rate: 0.10

Nina H.: eval snippet for telemetry/eval teams to run:
```
# run local slice tests
for model in ['orion9p-int4','orion9p-int6']:
  r = run_eval(model=model, dataset='convo_edge_cases', seed=123)
  print(model, r.metrics['helpfulness'], r.metrics['persona_drift'])
```
